title: RPG · attack with an available skill
description: Game decision with numeric facts as evidence.
case: A short RPG fight: turn 1, the player approaches; turn 2, the monster blocks; turn 3, it is the monster turn. The monster has 60/80 HP and zero mana. The enemy player is 1 meter away. Claw is ready, costs zero mana and reaches 2 meters. Frost Snare costs 10 mana. Heal costs 20 mana. The retreat path is blocked. Game policy: use an available attack when healthy and unable to retreat.

decisions.instructions: Which action is available and follows the game policy?

criteria.0: Attack the nearby player with Claw
criteria.1: Use Frost Snare without the required mana
criteria.2: Use Heal without the required mana

decisions.instructions: Does the monster have enough mana to use Heal?
